parameters.definition_en: Intercept c of the Mohr-Coulomb envelope on the shear-stress axis: the shear strength at zero normal stress before any loss of strength. In Softening-Hardening it is the cohesion reached at failure by the hardening law.
parameters.definition_es: Ordenada en el origen c de la envolvente de Mohr-Coulomb: resistencia al corte con tensión normal nula antes de cualquier pérdida de resistencia. En Softening-Hardening es la cohesión que alcanza la ley de endurecimiento en rotura.
parameters.range_en: Granular soils: c' = 0. Compacted soils (USBR data, effective envelope): 0-342 kPa as compacted, 0-22 kPa saturated. Rock masses (RMR classes V to I): < 100 to > 400 kPa.
parameters.range_es: Suelos granulares: c' = 0. Suelos compactados (datos USBR, envolvente efectiva): 0-342 kPa compactado, 0-22 kPa saturado. Macizos rocosos (clases RMR V a I): < 100 a > 400 kPa.
parameters.locator: Definition: Drucker & Prager 1952 eq. 1 and Fig. 1; Hoek 2023 ch. 4 eq. 1 (PDF p. 79). Ranges: GEC 5 §5.6.2.4 p. 163 (c' = 0 granular); UFC 3-220-01N Table 8-1.4 pp. 8-20 to 8-24 (PDF pp. 48-52), columns 'Cohesion (as compacted)' and 'Cohesion (saturated)', range taken over all USCS groups

parameters.definition_en: Slope angle phi of the Mohr-Coulomb envelope: the rate at which shear strength grows with normal stress before any loss of strength. In Softening-Hardening it is the ultimate (failure) friction angle that the mobilised friction angle hardens towards.
parameters.definition_es: Ángulo phi de la pendiente de la envolvente de Mohr-Coulomb: ritmo al que crece la resistencia al corte con la tensión normal antes de cualquier pérdida de resistencia. En Softening-Hardening es el ángulo de rozamiento último (en rotura) al que tiende el ángulo movilizado.
parameters.range_en: Soils: 15-45 deg (clays up to about 30 deg, sands higher); clean quartz sands 30-50 deg; compacted soils 19 deg (CH) to > 38 deg (GW, SW). Rock masses (RMR classes V to I): < 15 to > 45 deg.
parameters.range_es: Suelos: 15-45° (arcillas hasta unos 30°, arenas más); arenas cuarzosas limpias 30-50°; suelos compactados de 19° (CH) a > 38° (GW, SW). Macizos rocosos (clases RMR V a I): < 15° a > 45°.
parameters.locator: Definition: Drucker & Prager 1952 eq. 1, Fig. 1; Hoek 2023 ch. 4 eq. 1 (PDF p. 79). Ranges: Vermeer & de Borst 1984 §3.4 p. 15; GEC 5 §5.6.2.4 p. 163; UFC 3-220-01N Table 8-1.4 (PDF pp. 48-52), column 'Effective stress envelope, deg'; Hoek 2023 ch. 12 Table 4 part D after Bieniawski 1989 (PDF p. 246).

parameters.definition_en: Friction angle of the Mohr-Coulomb envelope after failure, once the strength has dropped to its residual value at large displacement. It is lower than or equal to the peak friction angle.
parameters.definition_es: Ángulo de rozamiento de la envolvente de Mohr-Coulomb tras la rotura, cuando la resistencia ha caído a su valor residual a grandes desplazamientos. Es menor o igual que el ángulo de pico.
parameters.range_en: Clayey soils: about 5-32 deg, lower for higher clay fraction and liquid limit. Unfilled rock joints with little movement: 20-40 deg depending on rock type.
parameters.range_es: Suelos arcillosos: de unos 5 a 32°, menor cuanto mayores son la fracción arcillosa y el límite líquido. Juntas de roca sin relleno y con poco movimiento: 20-40° según la roca.
parameters.locator: Definition: Hoek 2023 ch. 4 eq. 2 (PDF p. 79); GEC 5 §5.6.2.2 eq. 59 p. 162. Ranges: GEC 5 Fig. 76 p. 166 (after Stark & Eid 1994), read from the curves (about 32 deg at low LL and CF <= 20 %, about 5 deg for CF >= 50 % and high LL); GEC 5 Table 43 p. 214 (after Barton 1973; Jaeger & Cook 1976).

parameters.definition_en: Dilatancy angle psi: the angle that replaces phi in the plastic potential and sets the ratio of plastic volume increase to plastic shear strain. psi = phi gives associated flow, psi < phi non-associated, and psi = 0 no plastic volume change.
parameters.definition_es: Ángulo de dilatancia psi: sustituye a phi en el potencial plástico y fija la relación entre el aumento de volumen plástico y la deformación plástica de corte. psi = phi da flujo asociado, psi < phi no asociado y psi = 0 sin cambio de volumen plástico.
parameters.range_en: About 0-20 deg for soils, concrete and rock; about 15 deg for very dense sand, a few degrees for loose sand, 0 for normally consolidated clay. Must not exceed the (residual) friction angle.
parameters.range_es: Entre 0 y 20° aproximadamente para suelos, hormigón y roca; unos 15° en arena muy densa, pocos grados en arena suelta y 0 en arcilla normalmente consolidada. No debe superar el ángulo de rozamiento (residual).
parameters.locator: Vermeer & de Borst 1984 eqs. 3.2-3.3 (p. 12-13), eqs. 4.14-4.16 (pp. 18-19), §3.3 pp. 13-15 (values), §3.4 p. 15 (phi much greater than psi)

parameters.definition_en: Pressure-sensitivity coefficient of the Drucker-Prager cone sqrt(J2) + q I1/3 - k = 0 (tension positive): how much the shear strength grows with mean stress. It corresponds to 3*alpha in Drucker & Prager's yield function alpha J1 + sqrt(J2) = k; q = 0 is the von Mises cylinder.
parameters.definition_es: Coeficiente de sensibilidad a la presión del cono de Drucker-Prager sqrt(J2) + q I1/3 - k = 0 (tracción positiva): cuánto crece la resistencia al corte con la tensión media. Equivale a 3·alfa en la función de fluencia de Drucker y Prager alfa J1 + sqrt(J2) = k; q = 0 es el cilindro de von Mises.
parameters.range_en: 0 (no pressure dependence) up to sqrt(3)/2 = 0.866 when matched to Mohr-Coulomb in plane strain (12 alpha^2 <= 1, i.e. sin phi <= 1).
parameters.range_es: De 0 (sin dependencia de la presión) a sqrt(3)/2 = 0,866 cuando se ajusta a Mohr-Coulomb en deformación plana (12 alfa² <= 1, es decir sen phi <= 1).
parameters.locator: Drucker & Prager 1952 eq. 2 (p. 158), eq. 10 (p. 159: 3 alpha / (1 - 3 alpha^2)^0.5 = sin phi), p. 160 (12 alpha^2 cannot exceed unity)

parameters.definition_en: Cohesion-like constant of the Drucker-Prager cone sqrt(J2) + q I1/3 - k = 0: the value of sqrt(J2) at failure when the mean stress is zero. It is the constant k of Drucker & Prager's yield function and, in plane strain, is linked to the Mohr-Coulomb c and phi.
parameters.definition_es: Constante de tipo cohesivo del cono de Drucker-Prager sqrt(J2) + q I1/3 - k = 0: valor de sqrt(J2) en rotura con tensión media nula. Es la constante k de la función de fluencia de Drucker y Prager y, en deformación plana, se relaciona con c y phi de Mohr-Coulomb.
parameters.locator: Drucker & Prager 1952 eq. 2 (p. 158) and eq. 10 (p. 159: c = k / (1 - 12 alpha^2)^0.5)

parameters.definition_en: Drucker-Prager pressure coefficient q that applies after failure, once the strength has dropped from peak to residual.
parameters.definition_es: Coeficiente de presión q de Drucker-Prager que se aplica tras la rotura, cuando la resistencia ha caído del pico al residual.
parameters.range_en: Same bounds as peak q (0 to 0.866 under the plane-strain Mohr-Coulomb match).
parameters.range_es: Mismos límites que q de pico (0 a 0,866 con el ajuste a Mohr-Coulomb en deformación plana).
parameters.locator: Drucker & Prager 1952 p. 160 for the bound.

parameters.definition_en: Coefficient q_psi that replaces q in the Drucker-Prager plastic potential sqrt(J2) + q_psi I1/3 = const and controls plastic volume change. q_psi = q gives the associated flow of Drucker & Prager (dilatancy always present when q > 0); q_psi < q is non-associated and q_psi = 0 gives no plastic volume change.
parameters.definition_es: Coeficiente q_psi que sustituye a q en el potencial plástico de Drucker-Prager sqrt(J2) + q_psi I1/3 = cte y controla el cambio de volumen plástico. q_psi = q da el flujo asociado de Drucker y Prager (siempre hay dilatancia si q > 0); q_psi < q es no asociado y q_psi = 0 no produce cambio de volumen plástico.
parameters.range_en: 0 to q (peak or residual q).
parameters.range_es: De 0 a q (q de pico o residual).
parameters.locator: Drucker & Prager 1952 eqs. 3-5 (p. 158: associated flow, plastic dilatation 3 alpha lambda); Vermeer & de Borst 1984 §3.4 p. 15-16 (friction much greater than dilatancy, so non-associated flow is needed).

parameters.definition_en: Chooses which elastic constant is held fixed in Cam-Clay, whose bulk modulus is not constant but grows with mean stress and specific volume (slope kappa of the swelling line). Constant Poisson Ratio: G changes with the bulk modulus; Constant Shear Modulus: G is fixed and nu changes.
parameters.definition_es: Elige qué constante elástica se mantiene fija en Cam-Clay, cuyo módulo volumétrico no es constante sino que crece con la tensión media y el volumen específico (pendiente kappa de la línea de descarga). Coeficiente de Poisson constante: G varía con el módulo volumétrico; módulo de corte constante: G es fijo y nu varía.
parameters.range_en: Options: Constant Poisson Ratio | Constant Shear Modulus
parameters.range_es: Opciones: Coeficiente de Poisson constante | Módulo de corte constante
parameters.locator: either G or nu must be given) and Figs. 8.5-8.6 (constant nu vs constant G). Relation K = 2(1+nu)G / (3(1-2nu)): Itasca NorSand page, Elastic Law.

parameters.definition_en: Reference mean effective stress at which the shear modulus equals G_ref in G = G_ref (p'/p_ref)^m.
parameters.definition_es: Tensión media efectiva de referencia a la que el módulo de corte vale G_ref en G = G_ref (p'/p_ref)^m.
parameters.range_en: Usually 100 kPa (about atmospheric pressure).
parameters.range_es: Normalmente 100 kPa (del orden de la presión atmosférica).
parameters.locator: Itasca FLAC3D 9.2 NorSand page, 'Elastic Law' and property 'pressure-reference' (default 100 kPa, should match atmospheric pressure)

parameters.definition_en: Exponent m of the stress dependence of the shear modulus, G = G_ref (p'/p_ref)^m. m = 0 gives a constant G and m = 1 a G proportional to mean stress (constant rigidity G_ref/p_ref).
parameters.definition_es: Exponente m de la dependencia del módulo de corte con la tensión, G = G_ref (p'/p_ref)^m. m = 0 da G constante y m = 1 un G proporcional a la tensión media (rigidez G_ref/p_ref constante).
parameters.range_en: 0 to 1; 0.5 in the Hardin & Drnevich (1972) and Seed & Idriss (1971) small-strain correlations for soils.
parameters.range_es: De 0 a 1; 0,5 en las correlaciones a pequeñas deformaciones de Hardin y Drnevich (1972) y Seed e Idriss (1971) para suelos.
parameters.locator: Itasca FLAC3D 9.2 NorSand page, 'Elastic Law' (0 <= m <= 1); UFC 3-220-01N eqs. 12-23 and 12-24, pp. 12-19 to 12-20 (G proportional to sigma'0^0.5)

parameters.definition_en: Poisson's ratio used by NorSand to obtain the elastic bulk modulus from the current shear modulus, K = 2(1 + nu) G / (3(1 - 2 nu)).
parameters.definition_es: Coeficiente de Poisson que usa NorSand para obtener el módulo volumétrico elástico a partir del módulo de corte actual, K = 2(1 + nu) G / (3(1 - 2 nu)).
parameters.range_en: Drained soils at working loads 0.1-0.2; soils in general 0-0.3.
parameters.range_es: Suelos drenados en cargas de servicio 0,1-0,2; suelos en general 0-0,3.
parameters.locator: Itasca FLAC3D 9.2 NorSand page, 'Elastic Law' (K from G and nu; default 0.2); GEC 5 §5.5.3 p. 151; Vermeer & de Borst 1984 §3.1 p. 11

parameters.definition_en: Uniaxial compressive strength σci of the intact rock pieces (laboratory scale), the stress that scales the Hoek-Brown envelope.
parameters.definition_es: Resistencia a compresión simple σci de la roca intacta (escala de probeta), tensión que escala la envolvente de Hoek-Brown.
parameters.range_en: 0.25 to >250 MPa (grades R0 extremely weak to R6 extremely strong)
parameters.range_es: 0,25 a >250 MPa (grados R0 extremadamente débil a R6 extremadamente resistente)
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, eq. 1 and its definitions; Hoek 2023, Rock mass properties, Fig. 1 (field estimates of UCS, grades after Brown 1981), PDF p. 93

parameters.definition_en: Hoek-Brown constant m of the rock mass, entered directly; it controls the curvature and frictional part of the envelope (equal to mi for intact rock, lower for jointed rock).
parameters.definition_es: Constante m de Hoek-Brown del macizo rocoso, introducida directamente; controla la curvatura y la parte friccional de la envolvente (igual a mi en roca intacta, menor en roca diaclasada).
parameters.range_en: 0 < mb ≤ mi (mb = mi for intact rock)
parameters.range_es: 0 < mb ≤ mi (mb = mi en roca intacta)
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, eq. 1 (original criterion, constant m) and eq. 3 (mb = mi·exp((GSI-100)/(28-14D)), whose factor is ≤ 1 for GSI ≤ 100)

parameters.definition_en: Hoek-Brown constant s of the rock mass, entered directly; it expresses how fractured the mass is and sets its uniaxial and tensile strength.
parameters.definition_es: Constante s de Hoek-Brown del macizo rocoso, introducida directamente; expresa el grado de fracturación y fija la resistencia a compresión simple y a tracción del macizo.
parameters.range_en: 0 < s ≤ 1 (s = 1 for intact rock)
parameters.range_es: 0 < s ≤ 1 (s = 1 en roca intacta)
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, definitions after eq. 1 (s = 1 for intact rock) and eq. 4

parameters.definition_en: How the rock mass constants mb, s and a are obtained. With 'GSI' (the only option here) they are computed from GSI, mi and D.
parameters.definition_es: Modo de obtener las constantes del macizo mb, s y a. Con 'GSI' (única opción aquí) se calculan a partir de GSI, mi y D.
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, eqs. 3, 4 and 5

parameters.definition_en: Uniaxial compressive strength σci of the intact rock pieces (laboratory scale); one of the three basic inputs of the criterion with mi and GSI.
parameters.definition_es: Resistencia a compresión simple σci de la roca intacta (escala de probeta); uno de los tres datos básicos del criterio junto con mi y GSI.
parameters.range_en: 0.25 to >250 MPa (grades R0 extremely weak to R6 extremely strong)
parameters.range_es: 0,25 a >250 MPa (grados R0 extremadamente débil a R6 extremadamente resistente)
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, eqs. 1-2; Hoek 2023, Rock mass properties, list of the three required properties (PDF p. 92) and Fig. 1 (PDF p. 93)

parameters.definition_en: Geological Strength Index: a rating of the rock mass from its structure (interlocking of blocks) and the condition of discontinuity surfaces, used to reduce intact-rock properties to rock-mass values.
parameters.definition_es: Índice de resistencia geológica: valoración del macizo rocoso según su estructura (trabazón de bloques) y el estado de las superficies de las discontinuidades, con la que se reducen las propiedades de la roca intacta a las del macizo.
parameters.range_en: About 10 (laminated/sheared, very poor surfaces) to 90 (intact or massive, very good surfaces) on the chart; quote a range rather than a single value
parameters.range_es: Aproximadamente 10 (laminado/cizallado, superficies muy malas) a 90 (intacto o masivo, superficies muy buenas) en el ábaco; mejor dar un intervalo que un valor único
parameters.locator: Hoek 2023, Rock mass properties, 'Geological Strength Index' and Fig. 6 (GSI chart after Hoek and Marinos 2000), PDF pp. 98-99; Marinos & Hoek 2000, section 3 and Tables 5-13 (typical GSI ranges by rock type); Hoek et al. 2013, eq. 1 (GSI = 1.5 JCond89 + RQD/2)

parameters.definition_en: Hoek-Brown material constant of the intact rock, related to its frictional properties; it depends on rock type, texture and mineralogy.
parameters.definition_es: Constante de material de Hoek-Brown de la roca intacta, ligada a sus propiedades friccionales; depende del tipo de roca, la textura y la mineralogía.
parameters.range_en: About 4 (claystones) to 32 (granite)
parameters.range_es: Aproximadamente 4 (argilitas) a 32 (granito)
parameters.locator: Hoek, Practical Rock Engineering ch. 11, Table 3 (values of mi by rock group), p. 6; Marinos & Hoek 2000, section 2.0 and Table 2

parameters.definition_en: Disturbance factor D: degree of damage of the rock mass by blasting and stress relaxation; it reduces mb, s and the rock mass modulus.
parameters.definition_es: Factor de alteración D: grado de daño del macizo por voladuras y relajación de tensiones; reduce mb, s y el módulo de deformación del macizo.
parameters.range_en: 0 (undisturbed in situ rock mass) to 1 (very disturbed); guideline values 0, 0.5, 0.7, 0.8 and 1.0
parameters.range_es: 0 (macizo in situ inalterado) a 1 (muy alterado); valores orientativos 0; 0,5; 0,7; 0,8 y 1,0
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, text after eq. 5 and section 7, Table 1; Hoek 2023, Rock mass properties, PDF p. 102 and Fig. 9 (PDF p. 103); Hoek & Diederichs 2006, eqs. 2 and 4 and section 7

parameters.definition_en: Young's modulus Ei of the intact rock; used only by the Generalized Hoek & Diederichs (2006) method to estimate the rock mass modulus. If not measured it can be estimated as Ei = MR·σci.
parameters.definition_es: Módulo de Young Ei de la roca intacta; solo lo usa el método Generalized Hoek & Diederichs (2006) para estimar el módulo del macizo. Si no se ha medido puede estimarse como Ei = MR·σci.
parameters.range_en: Ei/σci = MR ≈ 150 to 1100 depending on rock type
parameters.range_es: Ei/σci = MR ≈ 150 a 1100 según el tipo de roca
parameters.locator: Hoek & Diederichs 2006, eq. 3 and Table 3 (p. 210); Hoek 2023, Rock mass properties, eq. 21 and Fig. 13 (PDF pp. 108-110)

parameters.definition_en: Empirical equation used to estimate the rock mass deformation modulus Erm: Generalized Hoek & Diederichs (2006) uses Ei, GSI and D; Simplified Hoek & Diederichs (2006) uses GSI and D only; Hoek, Carranza-Torres & Corkum (2002) uses σci, GSI and D.
parameters.definition_es: Ecuación empírica para estimar el módulo de deformación del macizo Erm: Generalized Hoek & Diederichs (2006) usa Ei, GSI y D; Simplified Hoek & Diederichs (2006) solo GSI y D; Hoek, Carranza-Torres & Corkum (2002) usa σci, GSI y D.
parameters.locator: Hoek & Diederichs 2006, eq. 2 (simplified, p. 208), eq. 4 (generalized, p. 209), section 6 (recommendation, p. 209) and Table 1 eq. 7 (2002 equation, σci ≤ 100 MPa, p. 204); Hoek et al. 2002, eq. 11; Hoek 2023, Rock mass properties, eqs. 20 and 22 (PDF p. 108)

parameters.definition_en: Option for a tension cutoff σ3 = T on the envelope. With 'None' (the only option here) no cutoff is added and the tensile limit is the criterion's own, σt = -s·σci/mb.
parameters.definition_es: Opción de corte a tracción σ3 = T sobre la envolvente. Con 'None' (única opción aquí) no se añade corte y el límite a tracción es el propio del criterio, σt = -s·σci/mb.
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, eq. 7

parameters.definition_en: Upper limit of the minor principal stress σ3 of the range over which the equivalent Mohr-Coulomb line is fitted to the curved envelope; it changes c and φ but not the parameters of the curved criterion.
parameters.definition_es: Límite superior de la tensión principal menor σ3 del intervalo en que se ajusta la recta de Mohr-Coulomb equivalente a la envolvente curva; cambia c y φ pero no los parámetros del criterio curvo.
parameters.range_en: Must be set case by case; earlier guidance: 0.25·σci for tunnels deeper than 30 m, σv = depth × unit weight for shallow tunnels and slopes
parameters.range_es: Debe fijarse en cada caso; criterio anterior: 0,25·σci para túneles a más de 30 m, σv = profundidad × peso específico para túneles someros y taludes
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, section 4 (fit over σt < σ3 < σ3max, eqs. 12-13) and section 6; Marinos & Hoek 2000, sections 2.1 and 2.2

parameters.definition_en: How σ3max is set: Custom (typed by the user), Tunnel (σ3max/σ'cm = 0.47(σ'cm/γH)^-0.94, gives equivalent ground reaction curves) or Slope (σ3max/σ'cm = 0.72(σ'cm/γH)^-0.91, gives equivalent factor of safety and failure surface).
parameters.definition_es: Modo de fijar σ3max: Custom (lo escribe el usuario), Tunnel (σ3max/σ'cm = 0,47(σ'cm/γH)^-0,94, da curvas características equivalentes) o Slope (σ3max/σ'cm = 0,72(σ'cm/γH)^-0,91, da coeficiente de seguridad y superficie de rotura equivalentes).
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, section 6, eqs. 18 (tunnels) and 19 (slopes), Fig. 2; Hoek 2023, Rock mass properties, eqs. 17-18, PDF pp. 106-107

parameters.definition_en: Unit weight γ of the rock mass, used with the depth or height H to form the overburden stress γH in the σ3max equations.
parameters.definition_es: Peso específico γ del macizo rocoso, que con la profundidad o altura H da la tensión de recubrimiento γH en las ecuaciones de σ3max.
parameters.range_en: Typically about 0.027 MN/m³ (2.7 t/m³)
parameters.range_es: Típicamente unos 0,027 MN/m³ (2,7 t/m³)
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, definitions after eq. 18; Hoek 2023, In situ and induced stresses, 'In situ stresses', PDF p. 133

parameters.definition_en: Depth H of the tunnel below the ground surface, used in the tunnel σ3max equation.
parameters.definition_es: Profundidad H del túnel bajo la superficie, usada en la ecuación de σ3max para túneles.
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, section 6, eq. 18 and following text

parameters.definition_en: Height H of the slope, used in the slope σ3max equation.
parameters.definition_es: Altura H del talud, usada en la ecuación de σ3max para taludes.
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, section 6, eq. 19

parameters.definition_en: Computed Hoek-Brown constant of the rock mass: mi reduced according to GSI and D.
parameters.definition_es: Constante de Hoek-Brown del macizo calculada: mi reducida según GSI y D.
parameters.range_en: 0 < mb ≤ mi
parameters.range_es: 0 < mb ≤ mi
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, eq. 3

parameters.definition_en: Computed rock mass constant s from GSI and D; it falls from 1 for intact rock as the mass becomes more fractured or disturbed.
parameters.definition_es: Constante s del macizo calculada a partir de GSI y D; baja desde 1 en roca intacta a medida que el macizo está más fracturado o alterado.
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, eq. 4 and definitions after eq. 1

parameters.definition_en: Computed exponent a of the generalized criterion, a function of GSI only; it replaces the 0.5 of the original criterion.
parameters.definition_es: Exponente a calculado del criterio generalizado, función solo de GSI; sustituye al 0,5 del criterio original.
parameters.range_en: From 0.5 (GSI = 100) to about 0.67 (very low GSI)
parameters.range_es: De 0,5 (GSI = 100) a unos 0,67 (GSI muy bajo)
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, eq. 5

parameters.definition_en: Tensile strength of the rock mass, σt = -s·σci/mb, obtained for equal biaxial tension; for brittle rock it is taken equal to the uniaxial tensile strength.
parameters.definition_es: Resistencia a tracción del macizo, σt = -s·σci/mb, obtenida en tracción biaxial igual; en roca frágil se toma igual a la resistencia a tracción uniaxial.
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, eq. 7 and following text

parameters.definition_en: Uniaxial compressive strength of the rock mass, σc = σci·s^a (criterion at σ3 = 0); failure starts at an excavation boundary when it is exceeded.
parameters.definition_es: Resistencia a compresión simple del macizo, σc = σci·s^a (criterio con σ3 = 0); la rotura se inicia en el contorno de la excavación cuando se supera.
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, eq. 6 and section 5

parameters.definition_en: Global rock mass strength σ'cm: the overall strength of the mass (e.g. a pillar), from a Mohr-Coulomb fit over σt < σ3 < σci/4; it is also the input of the tunnel and slope σ3max equations.
parameters.definition_es: Resistencia global del macizo σ'cm: resistencia de conjunto del macizo (p. ej. un pilar), a partir de un ajuste de Mohr-Coulomb en σt < σ3 < σci/4; es también el dato de las ecuaciones de σ3max para túneles y taludes.
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, section 5, eqs. 16-17

parameters.definition_en: Equivalent Mohr-Coulomb cohesion c': intercept of the straight line that balances the areas above and below the curved envelope over σt < σ3 < σ3max.
parameters.definition_es: Cohesión equivalente de Mohr-Coulomb c': ordenada en el origen de la recta que equilibra las áreas por encima y por debajo de la envolvente curva en σt < σ3 < σ3max.
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, section 4, eq. 13 (with σ3n = σ3max/σci)

parameters.definition_en: Equivalent Mohr-Coulomb friction angle φ': slope of the straight line fitted to the curved envelope over σt < σ3 < σ3max.
parameters.definition_es: Ángulo de rozamiento equivalente de Mohr-Coulomb φ': pendiente de la recta ajustada a la envolvente curva en σt < σ3 < σ3max.
parameters.locator: Hoek et al. 2002, section 4, eq. 12

parameters.definition_en: Rock mass deformation modulus Erm estimated with the selected Erm method from GSI, D and, depending on the method, Ei or σci.
parameters.definition_es: Módulo de deformación del macizo Erm estimado con el método elegido a partir de GSI, D y, según el método, Ei o σci.
parameters.locator: Hoek & Diederichs 2006, eqs. 2 and 4; Hoek et al. 2002, eq. 11

parameters.definition_en: Critical friction ratio: the stress ratio q/p' reached at the critical state, taken in triaxial compression as the reference condition. It sets the critical-state strength of the soil (it varies with Lode angle away from triaxial compression).
parameters.definition_es: Razón de rozamiento crítica: cociente de tensiones q/p' en el estado crítico, tomado en compresión triaxial como condición de referencia. Fija la resistencia en estado crítico del suelo (varía con el ángulo de Lode fuera de la compresión triaxial).
parameters.range_en: 1.2-1.5 (typical for sands)
parameters.range_es: 1,2-1,5 (típico en arenas)
parameters.locator: Jefferies, Shuttle & Been 2015, Notation (p. 67, symbol M) and Table 2 'NorSand soil properties with typical range for sands' (p. 78)

parameters.definition_en: Altitude of the critical state line: the void ratio on the CSL at a mean effective stress of 1 kPa. Together with lambda it fixes the critical void ratio at any stress level.
parameters.definition_es: Altura de la línea de estado crítico: índice de poros sobre la LEC para una tensión media efectiva de 1 kPa. Junto con lambda fija el índice de poros crítico a cualquier nivel de tensiones.
parameters.range_en: 0.9-1.4 (typical for sands)
parameters.range_es: 0,9-1,4 (típico en arenas)
parameters.locator: Jefferies, Shuttle & Been 2015, Notation (p. 67, symbol Gamma: reference void ratio on CSL at p' = 1 kPa) and Table 2 (p. 78)

parameters.definition_en: Plastic hardening modulus at zero state parameter: the dimensionless modulus that controls how fast the yield surface grows with plastic shear strain, with H = H0 - Hy psi. It is calibrated by forward modelling of drained triaxial tests.
parameters.definition_es: Módulo de endurecimiento plástico para parámetro de estado nulo: módulo adimensional que controla la velocidad con que crece la superficie de fluencia con la deformación plástica de corte, con H = H0 - Hy psi. Se calibra por modelización directa de ensayos triaxiales drenados.
parameters.range_en: 50-500 (typical range of the hardening modulus H for sands)
parameters.range_es: 50-500 (rango típico del módulo de endurecimiento H en arenas)
parameters.locator: Jefferies, Shuttle & Been 2015, Table 2 (p. 78, H: 50-500) and eq. 14 (p. 85, H = H0 - Hy psi; Fraser River sand H0 = 60, Hy = 280); Itasca 2025, property hardening-0 ('plastic hardening modulus when psi = 0')

parameters.definition_en: State-dilatancy coefficient: relates the maximum dilatancy (minimum D) to the state parameter, with triaxial compression as reference. It also sets the internal cap that limits the stress ratio a dense soil can reach.
parameters.definition_es: Coeficiente estado-dilatancia: relaciona la dilatancia máxima (D mínima) con el parámetro de estado, tomando la compresión triaxial como referencia. Fija también el cap interno que limita la razón de tensiones que puede alcanzar un suelo denso.
parameters.range_en: 2.5-4.5 (typical for sands)
parameters.range_es: 2,5-4,5 (típico en arenas)
parameters.locator: Jefferies, Shuttle & Been 2015, Notation (p. 67, chi: state-dilatancy parameter), Table 1 (p. 77, eta_L = M_i (1 - chi_i psi_i / M_i,tc)) and Table 2 (p. 78)

parameters.definition_en: Volumetric coupling coefficient taken from Nova's stress-dilatancy rule; together with chi_tc it governs the strength at peak dilatancy.
parameters.definition_es: Coeficiente de acoplamiento volumétrico tomado de la regla tensión-dilatancia de Nova; junto con chi_tc gobierna la resistencia en el pico de dilatancia.
parameters.range_en: 0.2-0.5 (typical for sands)
parameters.range_es: 0,2-0,5 (típico en arenas)
parameters.locator: Jefferies, Shuttle & Been 2015, Notation (p. 67, N 'volumetric coupling parameter (from Nova's flow rule)'), text p. 76 ('N the volumetric coupling following Nova (1982)') and Table 2 (p. 78)

parameters.definition_en: Switch that adds an optional softening term to the NorSand hardening rule (the Boolean S of the hardening law). It speeds the softening of loose sand in undrained shear; Itasca advises against using it for drained loading.
parameters.definition_es: Interruptor que añade un término opcional de reblandecimiento a la ley de endurecimiento de NorSand (el booleano S de la ley). Acelera el reblandecimiento de arenas sueltas en corte no drenado; Itasca desaconseja usarlo en carga drenada.
parameters.range_en: Off/on (S = 0 or 1)
parameters.range_es: Desactivado/activado (S = 0 o 1)
parameters.locator: Jefferies, Shuttle & Been 2015, Table 1 (p. 77, hardening rule on outer yield surface, 'S = 0 or 1 (a Boolean switch)'); Itasca 2025, property index-softening ('additional cap softening term S T_S ... optional'; not recommended for drained loading)

parameters.definition_en: Elastic: the material stays linear elastic at any stress, so the failure criterion never limits the stress and only shows how close the stress is to failure. Plastic: the stress cannot pass the yield (failure) surface; on reaching it the material deforms plastically and irreversibly, following the peak and residual strength and the flow rule.
parameters.definition_es: Elástico: el material es elástico lineal para cualquier tensión, de modo que el criterio de rotura no limita la tensión y solo indica lo cerca que está de la rotura. Plástico: la tensión no puede superar la superficie de fluencia (rotura); al alcanzarla el material se deforma plásticamente, de forma irreversible, según la resistencia de pico y residual y la regla de flujo.
parameters.range_en: Options: Elastic | Plastic (OGR Data offers only Plastic)
parameters.range_es: Opciones: Elástico | Plástico (OGR Data solo ofrece Plástico)
parameters.locator: Davis & Selvadurai 2002, §4.1 p. 83 (elastic response inside the yield surface, irreversible plastic flow on it) and §4.6 p. 95 (elastic inside, plastic on the surface); §4.3 p. 91 (perfectly plastic and work-hardening flow). The Elastic option is deduced from the definition of a linear elastic material (no yield surface active). Program: core/models.py lines 69 and 84 offer only 'Plastic'; no calculation reads the field (core/simulation.py build_model, lines 1218-1247, always builds a plastic model).

parameters.definition_en: On: the residual strength equals the peak strength, so after yielding the material is elastic-perfectly plastic and keeps a constant strength. Off: at the first yield the strength drops at once from the peak to the residual parameters and stays there (elastic-brittle-plastic, with no gradual softening).
parameters.definition_es: Activado: la resistencia residual es igual a la de pico, de modo que tras plastificar el material es elastoplástico perfecto y conserva una resistencia constante. Desactivado: en la primera plastificación la resistencia cae de golpe de los parámetros de pico a los residuales y se mantiene en ellos (elastofrágil-plástico, sin reblandecimiento gradual).
parameters.range_en: On | Off (default On)
parameters.range_es: Activado | Desactivado (por defecto, Activado)
parameters.locator: Perfect plasticity: Davis & Selvadurai 2002 §4.3 p. 91, Fig. 4.6; abrupt post-peak loss of strength (strain softening): ibid. §2.8 p. 49. Perfectly brittle drop from peak to residual parameters with no strain-dependent softening, and peak/residual definitions: Cai et al. 2007 p. 248 (Fig. 1) and p. 250. Choice by rock mass quality (elastic-brittle, strain softening, elastic-plastic): Hoek 2023, 'Rock mass properties', section 'Post-failure behaviour' and Fig. 14 (chapter pp. 19-21); Cai et al. 2007 p. 251. Peak versus residual strength of a sandstone: Vermeer & de Borst 1984 p. 38, Fig. 7.1. Program behaviour: core/simulation.py PerfectBrittleModel lines 635-663 (switch to the residual set in the first yielded step) and build_model/strengths lines 1222-1281.

parameters.definition_en: Tension cut-off T of the failed material: once the strength has dropped to the residual values, no principal effective stress may become more tensile than -T.
parameters.definition_es: Corte a tracción T del material ya roto: una vez que la resistencia ha caído a los valores residuales, ninguna tensión efectiva principal puede ser más traccionante que -T.
parameters.range_en: 0 <= T_res <= T_peak; 0 is the usual value after failure
parameters.range_es: 0 <= T_res <= T_pico; tras la rotura lo habitual es 0
parameters.locator: Tension cut-off on a cohesive-frictional Coulomb surface: Vermeer & de Borst 1984 §7.5 pp. 43-44. Residual tensile strength taken as zero after a brittle drop: Cai et al. 2007 p. 250. Bounds deduced: a residual (failed) state cannot be stronger than the peak one; negative values are read as 0 (core/simulation.py TensionCutoff, lines 421-430). Used only when Set Residual to Peak is off (core/simulation.py lines 1236 and 1241).

parameters.definition_en: Constant k of the residual Drucker-Prager cone sqrt(J2) = k + q·p' (p' mean effective stress, compression positive), which applies after the drop from peak: the shear strength sqrt(J2) at zero mean stress, the cohesion-like term of the cone.
parameters.definition_es: Constante k del cono residual de Drucker-Prager sqrt(J2) = k + q·p' (p' tensión media efectiva, compresión positiva), que se aplica tras la caída desde el pico: la resistencia al corte sqrt(J2) con tensión media nula, el término análogo a la cohesión.
parameters.range_en: k >= 0 and, for the residual cone to lie inside the peak one, k_res <= k_peak (with q_res <= q_peak). From Mohr-Coulomb c and phi: k = 2·sqrt(3)·c·cos(phi)/(3 - sin(phi)) (triaxial compression) or k = 3c/sqrt(9 + 12·tan²(phi)) (plane strain). A residual cohesion close to 0 gives k close to 0.
parameters.range_es: k >= 0 y, para que el cono residual quede dentro del de pico, k_res <= k_pico (con q_res <= q_pico). A partir de c y phi de Mohr-Coulomb: k = 2·sqrt(3)·c·cos(phi)/(3 - sen(phi)) (compresión triaxial) o k = 3c/sqrt(9 + 12·tan²(phi)) (deformación plana). Una cohesión residual próxima a 0 da k próximo a 0.
parameters.locator: Yield function alpha·J1 + sqrt(J2) = k: Drucker & Prager 1952 eq. 2, p. 158; plane-strain match to Mohr-Coulomb: eq. 10, p. 159. Triaxial-compression match q - xi·p = k with k = 6c·cos(phi)/(3 - sin(phi)): Davis & Selvadurai 2002 §3.5 eqs 3.19 and 3.22, p. 65 (divided by sqrt(3) because q = sqrt(3·J2)). Residual cohesion near zero: Cai et al. 2007 p. 250. Program form sqrt(J2) - k - q·p <= 0, compression positive: core/simulation.py DruckerPragerCone lines 446-482; used only when Set Residual to Peak is off (line 1236). Bounds deduced from the yield function (the cone shrinks when k and q decrease).

parameters.definition_en: m_psi, the value that replaces mb in the Hoek-Brown plastic potential and so sets the plastic volume change: m_psi = mb gives associated flow, smaller values less dilation, and m_psi = 0 none. The implied dilation angle falls with confinement: sin(psi) = (D - 1)/(D + 1), with D = 1 + m_psi/(2·sqrt(m_psi·sigma3/sigma_ci + s)).
parameters.definition_es: m_psi, el valor que sustituye a mb en el potencial plástico de Hoek-Brown y fija así el cambio de volumen plástico: m_psi = mb da flujo asociado, valores menores menos dilatancia y m_psi = 0 ninguna. El ángulo de dilatancia implícito disminuye con el confinamiento: sen(psi) = (D - 1)/(D + 1), con D = 1 + m_psi/(2·sqrt(m_psi·sigma3/sigma_ci + s)).
parameters.range_en: 0 <= m_psi <= mb
parameters.range_es: 0 <= m_psi <= mb
parameters.locator: Non-associated flow with a plastic potential of the same form as the yield function but with the friction term replaced by a dilatancy term: Davis & Selvadurai 2002 §4.5 eqs 4.20-4.24, pp. 94-95; Vermeer & de Borst 1984 eq. 4.14, p. 18. The Hoek-Brown form (mb -> m_psi) is deduced by that analogy and from the program: core/simulation.py Strength.hoek_brown and dSg, lines 341-372 (dS_g/dsigma3 = 1 + a·m_psi·(m_psi·sigma3/sigma_ci + s)^(a-1), a = 0.5); with m_psi = 0 the slope is 1 and, by Davis & Selvadurai eq. 4.24, the plastic volume change is zero; the angle formula follows from eq. 4.22, N = (1 + sin psi)/(1 - sin psi). Upper bound deduced from psi <= phi (dilatancy angle smaller than friction angle: Davis & Selvadurai p. 43; Vermeer & de Borst p. 16). Dilatancy fading at high confinement: Vermeer & de Borst p. 14.

parameters.definition_en: Law that gives the mobilized friction angle phi_m of the shear cone as the plastic deviatoric strain eps_q^p accumulates. Hyperbolic: tan(phi_m) = tan(phi_f)·eps_q^p/(eps_q^p + A), with the cohesion scaled so that the cone apex stays at c·cot(phi_f); Tabular: phi_m and c_m are read by linear interpolation from the Cone Hardening Table, which can also soften.
parameters.definition_es: Ley que da el ángulo de rozamiento movilizado phi_m del cono de corte según se acumula la deformación desviadora plástica eps_q^p. Hiperbólica: tan(phi_m) = tan(phi_f)·eps_q^p/(eps_q^p + A), con la cohesión escalada para que el vértice del cono quede fijo en c·cot(phi_f); Tabular: phi_m y c_m se interpolan linealmente en la tabla de endurecimiento del cono, que también permite reblandecimiento.
parameters.range_en: Hyperbolic | Tabular (default Hyperbolic)
parameters.range_es: Hiperbólica | Tabular (por defecto, Hiperbólica)
parameters.locator: Friction hardening with a mobilized friction angle that grows with an effective plastic strain: Vermeer & de Borst 1984 §6.1-6.2, eqs 6.3 and 6.7-6.8, pp. 33-35; variant with a fixed apex at c·cot(phi): eq. 6.14, p. 37; friction hardening combined with cohesion softening: §7.1, pp. 37-39. Hardening and softening concepts: Davis & Selvadurai 2002 §4.3 p. 91 and §7.3 p. 199. The hyperbolic law and the tabular option are read from the program: core/simulation.py SofteningHardeningModel.mobilized and .cohesion, lines 780-790; eps_q^p is the accumulated sqrt(2/3·e:e) of the deviatoric plastic strain increments of the cone (lines 828-838).

parameters.definition_en: Constant A of the hyperbolic cone hardening law tan(phi_m) = tan(phi_f)·eps_q^p/(eps_q^p + A): the plastic deviatoric strain at which tan(phi_m) reaches half of tan(phi_f) (and 90 % at 9A). A smaller A gives faster hardening.
parameters.definition_es: Constante A de la ley hiperbólica de endurecimiento del cono tan(phi_m) = tan(phi_f)·eps_q^p/(eps_q^p + A): la deformación desviadora plástica con la que tan(phi_m) alcanza la mitad de tan(phi_f) (y el 90 % con 9A). Un A menor da un endurecimiento más rápido.
parameters.range_en: A > 0 (dimensionless strain, decimal)
parameters.range_es: A > 0 (deformación adimensional, en tanto por uno)
parameters.locator: Deduced from the hardening law as implemented (core/simulation.py line 785): with eps_q^p = A, tan(phi_m) = tan(phi_f)/2; with eps_q^p = 9A, 0.9·tan(phi_f). A <= 0 is rejected (line 770). It plays the role of the constant of the friction-hardening law of Vermeer & de Borst 1984 (eq. 6.8, p. 35; p. 44: the strain needed to mobilize the limit friction angle).

parameters.definition_en: Rows of plastic deviatoric strain eps_q^p (decimal, not %), mobilized friction angle (degrees) and mobilized cohesion; values are interpolated linearly between rows and the last row holds beyond the end. A drop after a maximum models softening, e.g. the loss of cohesion of a cemented material.
parameters.definition_es: Filas de deformación desviadora plástica eps_q^p (en tanto por uno, no en %), ángulo de rozamiento movilizado (grados) y cohesión movilizada; los valores se interpolan linealmente entre filas y la última fila se mantiene más allá del final. Un descenso tras un máximo modela reblandecimiento, por ejemplo la pérdida de cohesión de un material cementado.
parameters.range_en: Strain >= 0 (rows sorted by strain); cohesion below 0 is read as 0; at least one row
parameters.range_es: Deformación >= 0 (las filas se ordenan por deformación); una cohesión negativa se lee como 0; al menos una fila
parameters.locator: Friction hardening and cohesion softening as functions of an effective plastic strain: Vermeer & de Borst 1984 §7.1, eqs 7.1-7.2, pp. 37-39, Fig. 7.2; post-peak test data are not objective: p. 13 and p. 44. Table handling from the program: core/simulation.py _table and _interp_table, lines 725-735 (rows sorted, linear interpolation, end values held), cohesion floor 0 at line 789.

parameters.definition_en: With the Mohr-Coulomb dilation type it is psi_f, the dilation angle reached when phi_m = phi_f; while hardening the program uses psi = psi_f·phi_m/phi_f. With the Compaction-Dilation type it is the angle whose stress ratio M_psi = 6·sin(psi)/(3 - sin(psi)) separates plastic compaction (q/p' < M_psi) from dilation (q/p' > M_psi), like a constant-volume friction angle.
parameters.definition_es: Con el tipo de dilatancia Mohr-Coulomb es psi_f, el ángulo de dilatancia que se alcanza cuando phi_m = phi_f; durante el endurecimiento el programa usa psi = psi_f·phi_m/phi_f. Con el tipo Compactación-Dilatancia es el ángulo cuyo cociente de tensiones M_psi = 6·sen(psi)/(3 - sen(psi)) separa la compactación plástica (q/p' < M_psi) de la dilatancia (q/p' > M_psi), como un ángulo de rozamiento a volumen constante.
parameters.range_en: Mohr-Coulomb type: 0 <= psi_f <= phi_f, usually 0-20° (about 15° very dense sand, a few degrees loose sand, 0° normally consolidated clay, 12-20° rocks). Compaction-Dilation type: about 25-38° for sands (constant-volume friction angle).
parameters.range_es: Tipo Mohr-Coulomb: 0 <= psi_f <= phi_f, normalmente 0-20° (unos 15° arena muy densa, pocos grados arena suelta, 0° arcilla normalmente consolidada, 12-20° rocas). Tipo Compactación-Dilatancia: unos 25-38° en arenas (ángulo de rozamiento a volumen constante).
parameters.locator: Dilatancy angle and its values: Vermeer & de Borst 1984 pp. 13-14 (dense sand 15°, loose sand a few degrees, NC clay 0, rocks 12-20°, all 0-20°) and p. 16 (psi much smaller than phi); Davis & Selvadurai 2002 p. 43 (psi < phi). Constant-volume angle: Vermeer & de Borst eqs 7.8-7.10, pp. 42-43 (contraction below phi_cv, dilation above; 25-33° for quartz sands). Cam-clay stress-dilatancy D = M - eta: Jefferies & Shuttle 2002 eq. 2, p. 626. Mtc = 1.13-1.53 for the sands of Jefferies & Been 2016 Table 2.1, pp. 46-47 (part in the extract), i.e. about 28-38° by M = 6·sin(phi)/(3 - sin(phi)) (Davis & Selvadurai eq. 3.22, p. 65, and p. 70). Program: core/simulation.py line 795 (psi = psi_f·phi_m/phi_f) and _n_psi lines 803-815 (D = M_psi - eta).

parameters.definition_en: Flow rule of the shear cone. Mohr-Coulomb: Mohr-Coulomb plastic potential with a mobilized dilation angle psi = psi_f·phi_m/phi_f that grows with hardening; Compaction-Dilation: Cam-clay-type stress-dilatancy D = d(eps_v^p)/d(eps_q^p) = M_psi - eta, so the soil compacts while eta = q/p' is below M_psi and dilates above it.
parameters.definition_es: Regla de flujo del cono de corte. Mohr-Coulomb: potencial plástico de Mohr-Coulomb con un ángulo de dilatancia movilizado psi = psi_f·phi_m/phi_f que crece con el endurecimiento; Compactación-Dilatancia: relación tensión-dilatancia tipo Cam-Clay D = d(eps_v^p)/d(eps_q^p) = M_psi - eta, de modo que el suelo compacta mientras eta = q/p' es menor que M_psi y dilata por encima.
parameters.range_en: Mohr-Coulomb | Compaction-Dilation (default Mohr-Coulomb)
parameters.range_es: Mohr-Coulomb | Compactación-Dilatancia (por defecto, Mohr-Coulomb)
parameters.locator: Mobilized dilatancy angle growing with hardening: Vermeer & de Borst 1984 §7.2 and §7.4, pp. 39-43. Stress-dilatancy D = M - eta of Cambridge-type models: Jefferies & Shuttle 2002 eqs 1-2, p. 626. Loose soil compacts, dense soil dilates: Davis & Selvadurai 2002 §7.3, pp. 193-194. Implementation: core/simulation.py lines 795-796 and 803-815 (M_psi = 6·sin(psi)/(3 - sin(psi)) of triaxial compression, converted to the flow of the Mohr-Coulomb faces).

parameters.definition_en: Optional yield surface (cap) that closes the shear cone on the mean-stress axis, so that isotropic or one-dimensional compression can cause plastic compaction. None: cone only; Vertical: p' <= pc; Elliptical: Modified-Cam-Clay-type ellipse (q/M)² + (p' + c·cot(phi_f))(p' - pc) = 0, shifted by the cohesion, whose top lies on the failure cone.
parameters.definition_es: Superficie de fluencia opcional (capa o cap) que cierra el cono de corte sobre el eje de tensión media, de modo que la compresión isótropa o unidimensional pueda producir compactación plástica. None: solo el cono; Vertical: p' <= pc; Elíptica: elipse tipo Cam-Clay Modificado (q/M)² + (p' + c·cot(phi_f))(p' - pc) = 0, desplazada por la cohesión, cuyo vértice está sobre el cono de rotura.
parameters.range_en: None | Vertical | Elliptical (default None)
parameters.range_es: None (ninguna) | Vertical | Elíptica (por defecto, None)
parameters.locator: Capped (closed) yield surface: Davis & Selvadurai 2002 §3.6, pp. 68-71, Fig. 3.17; Modified Cam Clay ellipse eq. 3.32, p. 71; closed surfaces need hardening: §7.1, p. 185. A cap closing the Coulomb surface to capture compaction under hydrostatic load: Vermeer & de Borst 1984 p. 44. Shapes from the program: core/simulation.py VerticalCap lines 666-683 and EllipticalCap lines 686-722 (M = 6·sin(phi_f)/(3 - sin(phi_f)), shift c/tan(phi_f), associated flow).

parameters.definition_en: Law by which the cap pressure pc grows with the plastic volumetric (compaction) strain of the cap eps_v^p. Cam-Clay: pc_new = pc·exp(Δeps_v^p/Λ), with Λ = Lambda Kappa, the Cam-clay normal-compression hardening; Tabular: pc read by linear interpolation from the Cap Hardening Table.
parameters.definition_es: Ley con la que crece la presión de capa pc con la deformación volumétrica plástica (de compactación) de la capa eps_v^p. Cam-Clay: pc_nueva = pc·exp(Δeps_v^p/Λ), con Λ = Lambda Kappa, el endurecimiento de compresión normal de Cam-Clay; Tabular: pc se interpola linealmente en la tabla de endurecimiento de la capa.
parameters.range_en: Cam-Clay | Tabular (default Cam-Clay)
parameters.range_es: Cam-Clay | Tabular (por defecto, Cam-Clay)
parameters.locator: Cam-clay hardening d(eps_p^p) = (lambda - kappa)·dp'o/(v·p'o): Wood 1990 §4.3, eqs 4.17-4.21, pp. 93-94. Logarithmic hardening with plastic volumetric strain: Davis & Selvadurai 2002 eqs 7.12-7.13, p. 196, and 7.25, p. 201. Implementation: core/simulation.py _cap_pressure, lines 840-850 (only compaction hardens; pc is updated at the end of each step).

parameters.definition_en: Plastic compressibility Λ of the Cam-Clay cap law pc_new = pc·exp(Δeps_v^p/Λ). By the Cam-clay hardening rule d(eps_v^p) = (lambda - kappa)·dpc/(v·pc), Λ = (lambda - kappa)/v: enter (lambda - kappa) divided by the specific volume v = 1 + e, not (lambda - kappa) alone.
parameters.definition_es: Compresibilidad plástica Λ de la ley de capa Cam-Clay pc_nueva = pc·exp(Δeps_v^p/Λ). Por la regla de endurecimiento de Cam-Clay d(eps_v^p) = (lambda - kappa)·dpc/(v·pc), Λ = (lambda - kappa)/v: hay que introducir (lambda - kappa) dividido por el volumen específico v = 1 + e, no (lambda - kappa) solo.
parameters.range_en: Λ >= 0; 0 = cap that does not harden (rigid). Λ = (lambda - kappa)/v from the soil's lambda, kappa and specific volume.
parameters.range_es: Λ >= 0; 0 = capa que no endurece (rígida). Λ = (lambda - kappa)/v a partir de lambda, kappa y el volumen específico del suelo.
parameters.locator: Wood 1990 §4.3, eq. 4.21, p. 94 (d(eps_p^p) = (lambda - kappa)·dp'o/(v·p'o)); integrated at constant v it gives p'o,new = p'o·exp(v·Δeps_p^p/(lambda - kappa)). Compared with the program's law, core/simulation.py line 847 (pc·exp(Δeps_v^p/Λ)), this gives Λ = (lambda - kappa)/v. Λ = 0 keeps pc constant (line 849), and so do negative values (line 846).

parameters.definition_en: Rows of accumulated plastic volumetric (compaction) strain of the cap eps_v^p (decimal) and cap pressure pc, interpolated linearly; the first row's pc is the initial cap position and pc stays constant beyond the last row.
parameters.definition_es: Filas de deformación volumétrica plástica acumulada (de compactación) de la capa eps_v^p (en tanto por uno) y presión de capa pc, interpoladas linealmente; la pc de la primera fila es la posición inicial de la capa y pc se mantiene constante más allá de la última fila.
parameters.range_en: eps_v^p >= 0; pc should increase with eps_v^p for hardening (a decrease would soften the cap); at least one row
parameters.range_es: eps_v^p >= 0; pc debe crecer con eps_v^p para que haya endurecimiento (un descenso reblandecería la capa); al menos una fila
parameters.locator: Cap size as a function of plastic volumetric strain: Davis & Selvadurai 2002 §7.3, eq. 7.13, p. 196. Table handling and initial pc = first row (raised to the initial mean stress if lower): core/simulation.py lines 776, 823-825 and 844-845; only compactive plastic strain of the cap is accumulated (line 843).

parameters.definition_en: Initial cap pressure pc0: the mean effective stress at which the cap first yields under isotropic compression (both cap shapes cut the p' axis at pc). It plays the role of a preconsolidation pressure for the cap.
parameters.definition_es: Presión inicial de la capa pc0: la tensión media efectiva a la que la capa plastifica por primera vez en compresión isótropa (las dos formas de capa cortan el eje p' en pc). Hace el papel de una presión de preconsolidación para la capa.
parameters.range_en: pc0 >= initial mean effective stress of the test (a lower value is raised to it)
parameters.range_es: pc0 >= tensión media efectiva inicial del ensayo (un valor menor se eleva hasta ella)
parameters.locator: Deduced from the program's use of the field: core/simulation.py line 766 (pc0), initial_state lines 822-825 (pc = max(pc0, p0)), VerticalCap line 675 (f = p - pc) and EllipticalCap lines 704-707 (q = 0 at p = pc). Cap position as a preconsolidation (yield) pressure: Davis & Selvadurai 2002 §3.6, pp. 68-69, and §7.3, p. 196; Wood 1990 §4.3, p. 94 (p'o sets the size of the yield locus).

parameters.definition_en: Chooses how the initial consolidation state of the NorSand sample is specified; the only option is OCR, the ratio by which the initial yield surface is larger than the one passing through the initial stress.
parameters.definition_es: Elige cómo se especifica el estado inicial de consolidación de la muestra NorSand; la única opción es OCR, el factor por el que la superficie de fluencia inicial es mayor que la que pasa por la tensión inicial.
parameters.range_en: OCR (only option)
parameters.range_es: OCR (única opción)
parameters.locator: Deduced from the program: models.py line 210 (enum with the single option 'OCR'); simulation.py NorSandModel.initial_state, line 1129 (p_i = OCR x the image stress that puts the initial stress on the yield surface). Meaning of the overconsolidation ratio in NorSand: Jefferies & Shuttle 2002, Fig. 1 p. 626 (R = sigma_m,max / sigma_m; R = 1 normally consolidated, R > 1 overconsolidated).

parameters.definition_en: Overconsolidation ratio of the initial state: the factor by which the initial NorSand yield surface (its image stress) is enlarged over the surface that passes through the initial stress. For an isotropic initial stress it equals the ratio of the largest past mean effective stress to the current one.
parameters.definition_es: Índice de sobreconsolidación del estado inicial: factor por el que se amplía la superficie de fluencia inicial de NorSand (su tensión imagen) respecto de la que pasa por la tensión inicial. Con tensión inicial isótropa coincide con el cociente entre la máxima tensión media efectiva pasada y la actual.
parameters.range_en: ≥ 1 (1 = normally consolidated, on the yield surface). Calibration-chamber sands were prepared at OCR 1 to about 15.
parameters.range_es: ≥ 1 (1 = normalmente consolidado, sobre la superficie de fluencia). Las arenas de cámara de calibración se prepararon con OCR de 1 a unos 15.
parameters.locator: Jefferies & Shuttle 2002, Fig. 1 p. 626 (R = sigma_m,max / sigma_m); Jefferies, Shuttle & Been 2015, Notation p. 66 (R, scalar measure of overconsolidation); Kulhawy & Mayne 1990, App. H p. H-1 and Table H-1 pp. H-2/H-3 (24 calibration-chamber sands, OCR 1 to about 14.7). Program: simulation.py line 1129 (p_i = OCR x image stress on the surface) and line 1066 (OCR < 1 rejected). Deduction: the NorSand yield surface scales with p_i, so its size on the p' axis is proportional to p_i; for an isotropic initial stress the factor OCR is therefore the ratio of past maximum to current mean stress, R.

parameters.definition_en: Initial state parameter: initial void ratio minus the critical-state void ratio at the initial mean effective stress (psi0 = e0 - e_c(p0)). Negative values mean a soil denser than critical, which dilates; positive values a looser, contractive soil.
parameters.definition_es: Parámetro de estado inicial: índice de poros inicial menos el índice de poros crítico a la tensión media efectiva inicial (psi0 = e0 - e_c(p0)). Valores negativos indican un suelo más denso que el crítico, que dilata; positivos, un suelo más suelto y contractivo.
parameters.range_en: Sands: about -0.25 (dense) to +0.1 (very loose); about -0.05 is lightly dilatant. Brasted sand tests: -0.02 (loose) to -0.20 (dense).
parameters.range_es: Arenas: de unos -0,25 (densa) a +0,1 (muy suelta); en torno a -0,05 es ligeramente dilatante. Ensayos en arena de Brasted: -0,02 (suelta) a -0,20 (densa).
parameters.locator: Definition: Jefferies & Been 2016, Fig. 1.1 and text p. 4 (dense soils negative, loose positive), eq. 2.6 p. 42 and p. 45 (psi_o measured with initial void ratio and e_c at initial mean stress). Values: Jefferies & Shuttle 2002, Table 4 p. 634 (Brasted sand psi0 -0.02, -0.11, -0.20) and Fig. 14 p. 636 (range of behaviour of sands, psi_i axis -0.25 to 0); Jefferies & Been 2016 p. 10 (Nerlerk fill 'extremely loose', psi ~ +0.1; psi < -0.03 marginally dilatant), p. 20 (Erksak hydraulic fill psi < -0.05), p. 25 (lightly dilatant sands psi ~ -0.05), Fig. 2.4 p. 42 (Kogyuk tests -0.04 to +0.11). Program: simulation.py line 1128 (e0 = e_c(p0) + psi0).

parameters.definition_en: Rate at which the plastic hardening modulus changes with the state parameter, H = H0 - Hy psi: denser states (negative psi) get a stiffer plastic response. With Hy = 0 the modulus is constant and equal to H0.
parameters.definition_es: Ritmo de variación del módulo de endurecimiento plástico con el parámetro de estado, H = H0 - Hy psi: los estados más densos (psi negativo) tienen una respuesta plástica más rígida. Con Hy = 0 el módulo es constante e igual a H0.
parameters.range_en: No general range published. Calibrated values: 280 (Fraser River sand, H = 60 - 280 psi) and about 1125 (Brasted sand, H = 50 - 1125 psi_i). H itself is typically 50-500.
parameters.range_es: No hay rango general publicado. Valores calibrados: 280 (arena del río Fraser, H = 60 - 280 psi) y unos 1125 (arena de Brasted, H = 50 - 1125 psi_i). El propio H suele valer 50-500.
parameters.locator: Jefferies, Shuttle & Been 2015, Table 2 p. 78 (Fraser River sand H '60-280 psi'; typical H 50-500); Jefferies & Shuttle 2002, eq. 25 p. 635 (Brasted sand Htc = 50 - 1125 psi_i, from fits H = 75, 150, 275 for psi0 = -0.02, -0.11, -0.20) and Table 3 p. 634 (H 50-500, 'often f(psi)'). Program: simulation.py line 1152 (H = H0 - Hy psi, with the current psi). Deduced bound: H must stay positive in the loosest state reached, so Hy < H0 / psi_max when psi > 0.

parameters.definition_en: Bulk modulus of the pore fluid: the pressure change needed per unit relative change of fluid volume, i.e. the inverse of its compressibility. In an undrained test it sets how much the pore fluid lets the soil change volume.
parameters.definition_es: Módulo de compresibilidad volumétrica del fluido intersticial: cambio de presión necesario por unidad de cambio relativo de volumen del fluido, es decir, la inversa de su compresibilidad. En un ensayo no drenado fija cuánto deja el fluido cambiar de volumen al suelo.
parameters.range_en: Water: about 2 x 10^6 kPa (2 GPa). Much larger values (e.g. the default 10^9 kPa) make the fluid practically incompressible.
parameters.range_es: Agua: unos 2 x 10^6 kPa (2 GPa). Valores mucho mayores (p. ej. el de defecto, 10^9 kPa) hacen el fluido prácticamente incompresible.
parameters.locator: Schofield & Wroth 1968, §4.1 p. 47 (typical compressibility of water 48 x 10^-6 cm²/kg, against 3000 x 10^-6 cm²/kg for London clay). Deduced: K_w = 1 / compressibility = 1 / (48 x 10^-6 cm²/kgf) = 20 800 kgf/cm² ≈ 2.0 x 10^6 kPa (1 kgf/cm² = 98.07 kPa). Davis & Selvadurai 2002, p. 33 (saturated soil in undrained deformation behaves as incompressible, Poisson's ratio 0.5). Program: simulation.py lines 60-69 and 1368-1395 (undrained tests impose zero volume change, i.e. an incompressible fluid).

parameters.definition_en: Elastic shear modulus at the reference mean stress p_ref in the NorSand power law G = G_ref (p'/p_ref)^m. It equals the dimensionless shear rigidity (G/p') at p_ref times p_ref.
parameters.definition_es: Módulo de corte elástico a la tensión media de referencia p_ref en la ley potencial de NorSand G = G_ref (p'/p_ref)^m. Equivale a la rigidez a cortante adimensional (G/p') en p_ref multiplicada por p_ref.
parameters.range_en: Sands, at p_ref = 100 kPa: 40 000-80 000 kPa (rigidity 400-800); the 2015 summary gives a rigidity of 100-800, i.e. 10 000-80 000 kPa. Brasted sand calibration: 50 000 kPa.
parameters.range_es: Arenas, con p_ref = 100 kPa: 40.000-80.000 kPa (rigidez 400-800); el resumen de 2015 da una rigidez de 100-800, es decir, 10.000-80.000 kPa. Calibración de la arena de Brasted: 50.000 kPa.
parameters.locator: Jefferies & Shuttle 2002, eq. 23 p. 633 (G / sigma_ref = Gref (sigma_m / sigma_ref)^g, sigma_ref commonly 100 kPa), Table 3 p. 634 (Gref 400-800, dimensionless, sigma_ref = 100 kPa) and p. 635 (Brasted sand Gref = 500); Jefferies, Shuttle & Been 2015, Notation p. 67 (Ir = G / sigma_m) and Table 2 p. 78 (Ir typical 100-800; Fraser River sand 450-750). kPa values computed as dimensionless rigidity x 100 kPa.

parameters.definition_en: Lower limit of the NorSand elastic shear modulus: the program uses the larger of G_ref (p'/p_ref)^m and G_min, so that G does not vanish as the mean stress tends to zero.
parameters.definition_es: Límite inferior del módulo de corte elástico de NorSand: el programa usa el mayor de G_ref (p'/p_ref)^m y G_min, para que G no se anule cuando la tensión media tiende a cero.
parameters.range_en: ≥ 0. It takes over only where G_ref (p'/p_ref)^m < G_min; with the defaults (G_min = 1 kPa, G_ref = 40 000 kPa, p_ref = 100 kPa, m = 0.5) only below p' ≈ 10^-7 kPa.
parameters.range_es: ≥ 0. Solo actúa donde G_ref (p'/p_ref)^m < G_min; con los valores por defecto (G_min = 1 kPa, G_ref = 40.000 kPa, p_ref = 100 kPa, m = 0,5) solo por debajo de p' ≈ 10^-7 kPa.
parameters.locator: Deduced from the program: simulation.py NorSandModel.moduli, line 1085 (G = max(G_ref (p/p_ref)^m, G_min)); stiffness_panel.py line 36 (input minimum 0). The threshold follows from G_ref (p'/p_ref)^m = G_min, i.e. p' = p_ref (G_min/G_ref)^(1/m) = 100 x (1/40 000)^2 kPa = 6 x 10^-8 kPa.

parameters.definition_en: Slope of the critical state line in void ratio versus natural logarithm of mean effective stress, e_c = Gamma - lambda ln(p'). It measures how fast the critical void ratio falls as the stress rises.
parameters.definition_es: Pendiente de la línea de estado crítico en el plano índice de poros - logaritmo natural de la tensión media efectiva, e_c = Gamma - lambda ln(p'). Mide lo rápido que baja el índice de poros crítico al aumentar la tensión.
parameters.range_en: Sands: 0.01-0.07 (natural log). In base 10 (lambda_10 ≈ 2.3 lambda): 0.03-0.15.
parameters.range_es: Arenas: 0,01-0,07 (logaritmo natural). En base 10 (lambda_10 ≈ 2,3 lambda): 0,03-0,15.
parameters.locator: Jefferies & Shuttle 2002, Table 3 p. 634 (lambda 0.01-0.07, 'defined on base e'); Jefferies, Shuttle & Been 2015, Notation p. 67 and Table 2 p. 78 (lambda_10 0.03-0.15); Jefferies & Been 2016, Table 2.1 pp. 46-47 (lambda_10 of some 60 sands, silts and tailings).

parameters.definition_en: M, slope of the critical state line in the p'-q plane (q = M p'): the stress ratio at which the soil keeps shearing at constant stress and volume. It also fixes the shape of the Cam-Clay and Modified Cam-Clay yield surfaces, whose top lies on this line.
parameters.definition_es: M, pendiente de la línea de estado crítico en el plano p'-q (q = M p'): relación de tensiones con la que el suelo sigue cortando a tensión y volumen constantes. Fija además la forma de las superficies de fluencia de Cam-Clay y Cam-Clay Modificado, cuyo punto más alto está sobre esa línea.
parameters.range_en: Clays: about 0.8-1.45 for PI 10-100 %, average about 1.0 (phi' ≈ 25°); Weald clay 0.87; five remoulded clays 0.85-1.02. Sands: 1.13-1.53. M = 6 sin phi' / (3 - sin phi') in triaxial compression.
parameters.range_es: Arcillas: de 0,8 a 1,45 para IP del 10 al 100 %, con media en torno a 1,0 (phi' ≈ 25°); arcilla de Weald 0,87; cinco arcillas remoldeadas 0,85-1,02. Arenas: 1,13-1,53. M = 6 sen phi' / (3 - sen phi') en compresión triaxial.
parameters.locator: Wood 1990, eq. 6.3 p. 141 (q_cs = M p'_cs), eq. 9.22 p. 271 (M from phi'), eq. 9.23 and Fig. 9.14 p. 271 (sin phi' = 0.35 - 0.1 ln Ip; average M ~ 1.0, phi' = 25.4°), eq. 6.25 p. 156 (Weald clay q = 0.872 p'); Kulhawy & Mayne 1990, eq. G-1 p. G-2 and Fig. 4-20 p. 4-22 (sin phi_cv ≈ 0.8 - 0.094 ln PI, PI in %); Schofield & Wroth 1968, Table 6.1 p. 109; Jefferies & Been 2016, Table 2.1 pp. 46-47 (Mtc of the sands and tailings listed in the extract: 1.13 Ottawa to 1.53 Northwest Brook Pit). Clay range computed from the Kulhawy & Mayne correlation with G-1 (PI 10 %: 1.45; PI 100 %: 0.84).

parameters.definition_en: Chooses which line the specific volume entered below belongs to: N, the isotropic normal compression line at unit pressure, or Gamma, the critical state line at unit pressure. The model links them: Gamma = N - (lambda - kappa) in Cam-Clay and Gamma = N - (lambda - kappa) ln 2 in Modified Cam-Clay.
parameters.definition_es: Elige a qué línea pertenece el volumen específico que se introduce: N, la línea de compresión normal isótropa a presión unidad, o Gamma, la línea de estado crítico a presión unidad. El modelo las relaciona: Gamma = N - (lambda - kappa) en Cam-Clay y Gamma = N - (lambda - kappa) ln 2 en Cam-Clay Modificado.
parameters.locator: Modified Cam-Clay (Roscoe & Burland 1968, as presented by Wood 1990 §5.1 p. 112 and Davis & Selvadurai 2002 p. 202; elliptical yield locus Wood eq. 5.5 p. 115): Wood 1990, eqs. 6.6-6.9 p. 143 and eqs. 6.10-6.11 p. 144 (Gamma = N - (lambda - kappa) ln 2), Table 11.1 p. 356 (Gamma + (lambda - kappa) ln 2 = N). Original Cam-Clay yield locus: Wood 1990 eq. 8.23 p. 237 (η/M = ln(p'o/p')). Cam-Clay: Schofield & Wroth 1968, eq. 6.20 p. 100 and eq. 7.18 p. 139 (normal compression line (lambda - kappa) above the critical state line). Program: simulation.py lines 891-896 (a Gamma value is converted to N with these relations).

parameters.definition_en: Specific volume v = 1 + e of the selected reference line (N: isotropic normal compression line; Gamma: critical state line) at a mean effective stress of 1 kPa. It places the line in the v-ln p' plane, so its value depends on the stress unit.
parameters.definition_es: Volumen específico v = 1 + e de la línea de referencia elegida (N: línea de compresión normal isótropa; Gamma: línea de estado crítico) para una tensión media efectiva de 1 kPa. Sitúa la línea en el plano v-ln p', por lo que su valor depende de la unidad de tensión.
parameters.range_en: With p' in kPa: Weald clay Gamma = 2.07; soft clay example Gamma = 2.5, N = 2.64. Five remoulded clays: Gamma ≈ 2.06-4.68 (converted from lb/in²).
parameters.range_es: Con p' en kPa: arcilla de Weald Gamma = 2,07; ejemplo de arcilla blanda Gamma = 2,5 y N = 2,64. Cinco arcillas remoldeadas: Gamma ≈ 2,06-4,68 (convertido desde lb/in²).
parameters.locator: Wood 1990, eq. 5.8 and Fig. 5.1c pp. 114-116 (N: v on the isotropic normal compression line at p' = 1), p. 144 (Gamma and N depend on the stress unit; the book uses kPa, so they are v at p' = 1 kPa), eq. 6.26 p. 156 (Weald clay csl v = 2.072 - 0.091 ln p', p' in kPa), Table 11.1 p. 356 (Gamma = 2.5, N = 2.64). Schofield & Wroth 1968, eq. 5.23 p. 73 and Table 6.1 p. 109 (Gamma 1.880-3.990 with p in lb/in²). Deduced conversion from v = Gamma - lambda ln p: Gamma(kPa) = Gamma(lb/in²) + lambda ln 6.895, giving Weald 2.06, Wiener Tegel V 2.37, London 2.76, kaolin 3.77, Klein Belt Ton 4.68; the Weald value agrees with Wood's 2.072. Program: simulation.py line 946 (v = N - lambda ln p with p in kPa) and line 947 (initial v must exceed 1).

parameters.definition_en: κ, slope of the unloading-reloading (swelling) line in the v-ln p' plane. It controls the recoverable volume change: the elastic bulk modulus is K = v p'/κ, so the soil stiffens as the mean stress grows.
parameters.definition_es: κ, pendiente de la línea de descarga-recarga (hinchamiento) en el plano v-ln p'. Controla el cambio de volumen recuperable: el módulo volumétrico elástico es K = v p'/κ, por lo que el suelo se rigidiza al aumentar la tensión media.
parameters.range_en: Usually about 0.2-0.25 λ (Λ = 1 - κ/λ ≈ 0.75-0.8); five remoulded clays 0.026-0.184; soft clay example 0.05 with λ = 0.25. From an oedometer swelling index: κ ≈ Cs/2.303 (Cs ≈ 0.2 Cc ≈ PI/370).
parameters.range_es: Normalmente en torno a 0,2-0,25 λ (Λ = 1 - κ/λ ≈ 0,75-0,8); cinco arcillas remoldeadas 0,026-0,184; ejemplo de arcilla blanda 0,05 con λ = 0,25. A partir del índice de hinchamiento edométrico: κ ≈ Cs/2,303 (Cs ≈ 0,2 Cc ≈ IP/370).
parameters.locator: Wood 1990, eq. 5.1 p. 113 (δε_p^e = κ δp'/(v p')), eq. 6.19 p. 147 (Λ = (λ - κ)/λ), Table 11.1 p. 356; Kulhawy & Mayne 1990, eq. G-2 p. G-2 (Λ = 1 - Cs/Cc, typically ≈ 0.8), Table 4-8 p. 4-48 (Λ 0.72-0.82, overall mean 0.75 from 138 tests), eqs. 6-8 and 6-9 p. 6-5 (Cur = Cc (1 - Λ) ≈ PI/370; average Cur about 20 % of Cc); Schofield & Wroth 1968, Table 6.1 p. 109 (average κ and Λ = 0.48-0.81 of five clays).

parameters.definition_en: λ, slope of the isotropic normal (virgin) compression line in the v-ln p' plane; the critical state line is parallel to it. It measures the irrecoverable compressibility and drives the hardening of the yield surface with plastic volumetric strain.
parameters.definition_es: λ, pendiente de la línea de compresión normal (noval) isótropa en el plano v-ln p'; la línea de estado crítico es paralela. Mide la compresibilidad irrecuperable y gobierna el endurecimiento de la superficie de fluencia con la deformación volumétrica plástica.
parameters.range_en: Clays: λ ≈ 0.6 Ip (Ip as a ratio); five remoulded clays 0.093-0.356; Weald clay 0.091; soft clay example 0.25. From an oedometer: λ = Cc/2.303, with Cc < 0.2 low, 0.2-0.4 moderate, > 0.4 high compressibility (λ < 0.09, 0.09-0.17, > 0.17).
parameters.range_es: Arcillas: λ ≈ 0,6 IP (IP en tanto por uno); cinco arcillas remoldeadas 0,093-0,356; arcilla de Weald 0,091; ejemplo de arcilla blanda 0,25. A partir del edómetro: λ = Cc/2,303, con Cc < 0,2 compresibilidad baja, 0,2-0,4 media y > 0,4 alta (λ < 0,09; 0,09-0,17; > 0,17).
parameters.locator: Wood 1990, eq. 5.8 p. 116, eqs. 9.13-9.17 pp. 264-265 (λ = Ip Gs / ln 100 ≈ 0.6 Ip; Cc = 2.303 λ) and Fig. 9.6 p. 264 (data), eq. 6.26 p. 156 (Weald 0.091), Table 11.1 p. 356; Kulhawy & Mayne 1990, Table 6-1 p. 6-4 (degree of compressibility by Cc), eqs. 6-5 to 6-7 pp. 6-4 (Cc = 0.009 (wL - 10); Cc ≈ PI/74), App. G p. G-2 (λ isotropic compression index); Schofield & Wroth 1968, Table 6.1 p. 109. λ limits of the compressibility classes computed as Cc/2.303.

parameters.definition_en: Chooses how the initial size of the yield surface is given: by the overconsolidation ratio OCR applied to the surface through the initial stress, or directly by the preconsolidation pressure Po.
parameters.definition_es: Elige cómo se da el tamaño inicial de la superficie de fluencia: mediante el índice de sobreconsolidación OCR aplicado a la superficie que pasa por la tensión inicial, o directamente con la presión de preconsolidación Po.
parameters.range_en: OCR | Preconsolidation Pressure (Po)
parameters.range_es: OCR | Presión de preconsolidación (Po)
parameters.locator: Wood 1990, eq. 5.3 p. 115 (the yield locus size is set by p'_o); Kulhawy & Mayne 1990, eq. G-3 p. G-2 (OCR_i = p_max / p_0). Program: models.py line 43 (options), simulation.py lines 897-900 and 939-945 (pc = OCR x pc on the surface, or Po).

parameters.definition_en: Isotropic overconsolidation ratio: preconsolidation mean effective stress divided by the current one (OCR_i = p'max / p'0). OCR = 1 starts on the yield surface (normally consolidated); OCR > 1 starts inside it and responds elastically first.
parameters.definition_es: Índice de sobreconsolidación isótropo: tensión media efectiva de preconsolidación dividida por la actual (OCR_i = p'max / p'0). OCR = 1 parte de la superficie de fluencia (normalmente consolidado); OCR > 1 parte del interior y responde primero de forma elástica.
parameters.range_en: ≥ 1. Intact clays: about 1 to 40 (vertical OCR, database of 96 clays); a reconstituted clay swelled from 827 to 34 kPa reaches 24 (heavily overconsolidated).
parameters.range_es: ≥ 1. Arcillas inalteradas: de 1 a unos 40 (OCR vertical, base de datos de 96 arcillas); una arcilla reconstituida descargada de 827 a 34 kPa llega a 24 (fuertemente sobreconsolidada).
parameters.locator: Kulhawy & Mayne 1990, eq. G-3 p. G-2 (isotropic OCR_i), eq. 3-2 p. 3-2 and p. 6-1 (vertical OCR = σ'p/σ'v0; NC = 1), Fig. 3-17 p. 3-17 (96 intact clays, OCR from 1 to about 40, read from the chart), eqs. 3-17 to 3-22 pp. 3-15/3-17 (OCR from liquidity index or su), Table 4-7 p. 4-33 (NC, lightly and heavily OC classes); Wood 1990, p. 151 (Weald clay compressed to 827 kPa and swollen to 34 kPa, OCR 24); Schofield & Wroth 1968, §7.10 p. 139. Program: simulation.py lines 939-945 (pc = OCR x the pc that puts the initial stress on the surface; for an isotropic initial stress this is p'0, so OCR = pc/p'0) and line 908 (OCR < 1 rejected).

parameters.definition_en: Po (p'c), the largest mean effective stress the soil has carried: the point where the yield surface meets the p' axis, which sets its size. Plastic compression makes it grow (hardening) and dilation on the dry side makes it shrink (softening).
parameters.definition_es: Po (p'c), la mayor tensión media efectiva que ha soportado el suelo: punto donde la superficie de fluencia corta el eje p', que fija su tamaño. La compresión plástica lo aumenta (endurecimiento) y la dilatancia en el lado seco lo reduce (reblandecimiento).
parameters.range_en: Site-specific. In the program: not below the value that puts the initial stress on the yield surface (p'0 for an isotropic start); lower values are raised to it.
parameters.range_es: Depende del emplazamiento. En el programa: no menor que el valor que sitúa la tensión inicial sobre la superficie de fluencia (p'0 si el estado inicial es isótropo); los valores menores se elevan a ese.
parameters.locator: Wood 1990, eq. 5.3 and Fig. 5.1 pp. 114-115 (p'_o, size of the yield locus) and eqs. 5.8-5.10 p. 116 (hardening with plastic volumetric strain); Davis & Selvadurai 2002, p. 196 (initial yield stress = upper point of the virgin compression curve, the preconsolidation stress); Kulhawy & Mayne 1990, p. 3-2 and §3 'Effective preconsolidation stress' pp. 3-6 to 3-14 (correlations, vertical σ'p). Program: simulation.py line 945 (pc = max(Po, pc on the surface)).

parameters.definition_en: Elastic shear modulus G kept constant in Cam-Clay when 'Constant Shear Modulus' is chosen: ratio of shear stress to elastic shear strain. With this choice Poisson's ratio varies with the mean stress.
parameters.definition_es: Módulo de corte elástico G que se mantiene constante en Cam-Clay al elegir «Módulo de corte constante»: cociente entre la tensión tangencial y la deformación angular elástica. Con esta opción el coeficiente de Poisson varía con la tensión media.
parameters.range_en: Clays (G = Eu/3, secant at design stress): soft 500-1300 kPa, medium 1300-2700 kPa, stiff 2700-6700 kPa; soft clay example 500 kPa. Small-strain Gmax is about 10-20 times larger (static G ≈ 5-10 % of Gmax).
parameters.range_es: Arcillas (G = Eu/3, secante a tensiones de proyecto): blandas 500-1300 kPa, medias 1300-2700 kPa, firmes 2700-6700 kPa; ejemplo de arcilla blanda 500 kPa. El Gmax a pequeñas deformaciones es unas 10-20 veces mayor (G estático ≈ 5-10 % de Gmax).
parameters.locator: Kulhawy & Mayne 1990, eq. 5-3 p. 5-2 (G = E / 2(1 + ν)), p. 5-4 (undrained Eu = 3G), Table 5-2 p. 5-6 (Eu/pa: soft 15-40, medium 40-80, stiff 80-200), p. 5-12 (static G about 5-10 % of dynamic Gmax), App. I p. I-1 (pa ≈ 100 kPa); Wood 1990, eq. 5.2 p. 114 (constant G') and Table 11.1 p. 356 (G' = 500 kPa); GEC 5 Table 30 p. 154 (small-strain G0 by soil type, round 1). kPa values computed as G = Eu/3 with pa = 100 kPa.

parameters.definition_en: Poisson's ratio ν of the linear isotropic elastic response: minus the ratio of lateral to axial strain under axial loading. With Young's modulus it fixes the shear modulus, G = E / (2(1 + ν)).
parameters.definition_es: Coeficiente de Poisson ν de la respuesta elástica lineal isótropa: cociente, cambiado de signo, entre la deformación lateral y la axial en carga axial. Junto con el módulo de Young fija el módulo de corte, G = E / (2(1 + ν)).
parameters.range_en: Soils, drained: clay 0.2-0.4, loose sand 0.1-0.3, dense sand 0.3-0.4 (0.1-0.2 is also quoted at working loads). Saturated soil, undrained: 0.5. Intact rock: typically 0.25-0.4 (0.11-0.58 measured on 72 Canadian rocks).
parameters.range_es: Suelos, drenado: arcilla 0,2-0,4, arena suelta 0,1-0,3, arena densa 0,3-0,4 (también se citan 0,1-0,2 en cargas de servicio). Suelo saturado no drenado: 0,5. Roca intacta: normalmente 0,25-0,4 (0,11-0,58 medidos en 72 rocas canadienses).
parameters.locator: Kulhawy & Mayne 1990, eq. 5-2 and eq. 5-3 p. 5-2, p. 5-3 (range 0-0.5 for isotropic elastic materials; undrained νu = 0.5) and Table 5-1 p. 5-4 (typical drained ν); Davis & Selvadurai 2002, eq. 2.13 p. 31 (-1 < ν ≤ 0.5) and p. 33 (undrained saturated soil ν = 0.5); GEC 5 §5.5.3 p. 151 (0.1-0.2 at working loads) and §6.4.1 p. 205 (rock 0.25-0.4); Vermeer & de Borst 1984 §3.1 p. 11 (definition); CANMET 1995 Table 1 (0.11-0.58, computed from the table).

parameters.definition_en: Young's modulus E of the linear isotropic elastic response: ratio of axial stress to axial strain under axial loading, before yield.
parameters.definition_es: Módulo de Young E de la respuesta elástica lineal isótropa: cociente entre la tensión axial y la deformación axial en carga axial, antes de la plastificación.
parameters.range_en: Sand (drained): loose 10 000-20 000, medium 20 000-50 000, dense 50 000-100 000 kPa. Clay (undrained): soft 1500-4000, medium 4000-8000, stiff 8000-20 000 kPa. Intact rock: typically 0.1-100 GPa (1.8-166 GPa measured on 72 Canadian rocks).
parameters.range_es: Arena (drenado): suelta 10.000-20.000, media 20.000-50.000, densa 50.000-100.000 kPa. Arcilla (no drenado): blanda 1500-4000, media 4000-8000, firme 8000-20.000 kPa. Roca intacta: normalmente 0,1-100 GPa (1,8-166 GPa medidos en 72 rocas canadienses).
parameters.locator: Kulhawy & Mayne 1990, eq. 5-1 p. 5-1 (definition; tangent and secant moduli), Table 5-5 p. 5-15 (drained sand Ed/pa: loose 100-200, medium 200-500, dense 500-1000), Table 5-2 p. 5-6 (undrained clay Eu/pa: soft 15-40, medium 40-80, stiff 80-200), App. I p. I-1 (pa ≈ 100 kPa); GEC 5 Table 28 p. 148 and §6.4.1 p. 205 (intact rock 0.1-100 GPa); CANMET 1995 Table 1 (1.76-166.3 GPa, computed from the table); Vermeer & de Borst 1984 §3.1 p. 11. kPa values computed with pa = 100 kPa.

parameters.definition_en: Tension cut-off T: no principal effective stress may become more tensile than -T (yield surface σ3 = -T, associated flow). It truncates the apex of the Mohr-Coulomb envelope; 0 means the material carries no tension.
parameters.definition_es: Corte a tracción T: ninguna tensión principal efectiva puede ser más traccionante que -T (superficie σ3 = -T, flujo asociado). Trunca el vértice de la envolvente de Mohr-Coulomb; 0 significa que el material no admite tracciones.
parameters.range_en: Uncemented soils: 0. Effective range 0 to c·cot φ: larger values have no effect. Intact rock (77 Canadian rocks): about 0.4-26 MPa.
parameters.range_es: Suelos no cementados: 0. Rango efectivo de 0 a c·cotg φ: valores mayores no tienen efecto. Roca intacta (77 rocas canadienses): de unos 0,4 a 26 MPa.
parameters.locator: Program: simulation.py class TensionCutoff lines 421-440 (σ_i ≥ -T, associated; negative input taken as 0) and _pyramid_set lines 600-607 (apex = max(MC apex, -T)). Deduced bound: the Mohr-Coulomb pyramid alone keeps every principal stress ≥ -sc/(Nφ - 1) = -c·cot φ (Strength.apex, line 351), so T ≥ c·cot φ never acts. Soils: Wood 1990, p. 115 (unless the particles are cemented, soil cannot carry an all-round tensile effective stress); Kulhawy & Mayne 1990, p. 4-2 (effective cohesion only in special cases: truly cemented, partially saturated or heavily overconsolidated clays). Rock: CANMET 1995 Table 1 (σt 0.43 MPa coal to 25.96 MPa andesite). Why the apex is cut: Vermeer & de Borst 1984 §6-7 pp. 43-44.

parameters.definition_en: Cohesion intercept of the Mohr-Coulomb envelope after failure, once the strength has dropped from peak to residual. Clays sheared to large displacement and rock joints are usually taken as cohesionless at residual.
parameters.definition_es: Cohesión de la envolvente de Mohr-Coulomb tras la rotura, cuando la resistencia ha caído del pico al residual. Las arcillas cizalladas a grandes desplazamientos y las juntas de roca suelen tomarse sin cohesión en estado residual.
parameters.range_en: 0 (residual envelopes of clays and joints pass through the origin); never above the peak cohesion.
parameters.range_es: 0 (las envolventes residuales de arcillas y juntas pasan por el origen); nunca mayor que la cohesión de pico.
parameters.locator: Wood 1990, pp. 221-222 and Fig. 7.37 (London clay: failures consistent with φ'cs = 20° and c' = 0; residual envelope through the origin; ring-shear residual φ'r ~ 9° for Kalabagh clay, Fig. 7.38); Kulhawy & Mayne 1990, p. 4-2 (c' = 0 except special cases) and pp. 4-24/4-25 (residual strength develops at very large strain with re-oriented clay particles); Hoek 2023 ch. 4 eq. 2 and Fig. 1 (c drops to zero at residual); GEC 5 §5.6.2.2 eq. 59 p. 162 (τr = σ' tan φr). Program: simulation.py lines 1255-1260 (read only when 'Set Residual to Peak' is off); upper bound deduced from the meaning of residual strength.
